_what_this_is: Decision template. NOT read by the setup planner. No Item is created from it.
_how_to_use: For each Item the business really wants: fill item_code and item_name, check item_group, set confirmed true. Delete or leave false anything not wanted. Add other by-products ONLY if confirmed (use the 'other_confirmed_by_products' list).
_how_it_is_applied: Confirmed entries are copied as {"role", "item_code", "item_name", "item_group"} into inventory_setup_approved.json 'items', the plan is rebuilt and its plan_hash reviewed before apply_plan(). Items are created as batch-tracked stock Items with no rate.
_rules: One shared Paddy Item. Raw vs Boiled paddy is told apart by the owning operating unit, not by a second Item.
Raw Rice and Boiled Rice are two separate Items.
Every recoverable by-product is its own stock Item, batch-tracked so the procurement season stays with it.
No purchase rate, valuation rate or price is part of this template.

items.stock_uom_note: Quintal needs float_precision 3 (see precision decision). If precision stays 2, the stock UOM would have to be Kg.
